$comment: Owns: the LLM router's data — providers, exact model ids, per-quota RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD limits and the chains per job kind. Limits change: update the numbers and `checked`, not the code. Moved from SPEC §9's src/ai/providers.json into the llm module (apps/worker/src/modules/llm/providers.json). Paid models (SPEC §9, 2026-10-08) are plain entries marked `paid: true` that lead both chains — Claude → ChatGPT → Gemini Pro — and are tried only when their key is set (the router skips a model without a key as no_key), so setting a key opts in and removing it falls back to the free chain; each paid quota's rpd is our own cost cap of 200 requests/day per provider (background jobs stop at 80 % of it), not the provider's limit. Free text chain priority (Aaron, 2026-10-06): Groq → OpenRouter → Gemini last. Vision has no Groq model, so OpenRouter leads free vision with Gemini last.

anthropic.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages — pay-as-you-go; prices per MTok in/out on each model's note.

openai.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing — pay-as-you-go; reasoning models take max_completion_tokens, not max_tokens.

gemini-paid.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing — Google issues one key for both tiers; GEMINI_PAID_API_KEY is the same key with billing on, named apart so setting it is the opt-in (a free-only key would fail every Pro call over with a billing error first).

gemini.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits — free-tier numbers are shown only in AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit); limits are per project, RPD resets at midnight Pacific.

zai.source: https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing (GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.6V-Flash are Free). Free Flash models are limited by concurrency (1 request in flight per model); no published daily cap — see https://z.ai/manage-apikey/rate-limits.

openrouter.source: https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/reference/limits — :free models: 20 RPM; 50 RPD account-wide (1,000 RPD after $10 of credits ever purchased).

anthropic-paid.note: Our own cost cap, not Anthropic's limit: 200 requests/day shared by the Claude models; background jobs stop at 80 %.

openai-paid.note: Our own cost cap, not OpenAI's limit: 200 requests/day shared by the ChatGPT models; background jobs stop at 80 %.

gemini-paid.note: Our own cost cap, not Google's limit: 200 requests/day for Gemini Pro; background jobs stop at 80 %.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Estimate (SPEC §9: roughly 5–15 RPM, up to 1,000/day). Google does not publish free-tier numbers outside AI Studio; replace with the values shown there.

glm-4.7-flash.note: Concurrency 1; rpm is our own pacing.

glm-4.5-flash.note: Concurrency 1; rpm is our own pacing.

glm-4.6v-flash.note: Concurrency 1; rpm is our own pacing.

openrouter-free.note: Shared by every :free model on the account. Second in the free text chain after Groq; this daily cap is reached before Gemini is tried.

anthropic-opus-5-5.note: $4 in / $20 out per MTok (2026-10-08). Swap the chain entry for anthropic-sonnet-5-5 or anthropic-haiku-5-5 to spend less.

anthropic-sonnet-5-5.note: $2 in / $10 out per MTok (2026-10-08). Not in a chain: edit the chain line to use it.

anthropic-haiku-5-5.note: $0.10 in / $0.50 out per MTok (2026-10-08). Not in a chain: edit the chain line to use it.

openai-gpt-6.1-sol.note: $2 in / $10 out per MTok (2026-10-08). The flagship gpt-6-astra is $10 / $50; openai-gpt-6-luna below is the cheap option.

openai-gpt-6-luna.note: $0.10 in / $0.50 out per MTok (2026-10-08). Not in a chain: edit the chain line to use it.

gemini-pro.note: $2 in / $12 out per MTok up to 200k context (2026-10-08). Paid only: no free tier.
